== Summary ==
Two players in striped shirts at the [[2009 World Championship]], October 2009, from Kevbozzz's "Worlds 2009" album. No one is named in the post.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by arebelspy: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=483640#p483640 post 483640], "Pics [Worlds 09]" (topic 31192), 17 November 2009. Photobucket album Kevbozzz/Worlds 2009, image IMG_1776.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).
